task_completion.description: The agent runs the baseline SUMO simulation for the Bologna Acosta network.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Terminal commands or GUI interaction showing the execution of sumo or sumo-gui using the bologna_acosta configuration files.

task_completion.description: The baseline trip information file is generated at the specified path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A file listing or terminal output showing /home/ga/SUMO_Output/tripinfos_baseline.xml has been created.

task_completion.description: The agent configures the AV scenario with carFollowModel='IDM' and tau='0.8'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal command (e.g., cat, sed, or xml editing) showing the modification of vehicle types to use IDM and a tau value of 0.8.

task_completion.description: The agent runs the modified AV simulation.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Terminal commands or GUI interaction showing the execution of the simulation resulting in /home/ga/SUMO_Output/tripinfos_av.xml.

task_completion.description: The agent calculates the mean duration for both scenarios and the difference.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Python scripts, terminal commands (grep/awk), or spreadsheet use showing the extraction of 'duration' values and calculation of averages.

task_completion.description: The agent creates the final text report with the exact required format and three lines.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or 'cat' command showing /home/ga/SUMO_Output/av_comparison.txt with the three lines: Baseline Avg Duration, AV Avg Duration, and Difference (Baseline - AV) to two decimal places.

integrity.description: The agent actually ran the SUMO simulations rather than just creating the text report manually.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots must show the SUMO progress bar in terminal or the SUMO-GUI running; the tripinfo XML files should be visible before the report is created.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply echo the final values without performing the data extraction.
integrity.visual_evidence: Evidence of the agent parsing the XML files (e.g., using scripts or command-line tools) to find the duration values.

integrity.description: The agent correctly applied the IDM and tau parameters to the vehicle types.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the configuration file or command line arguments where 'IDM' and '0.8' are explicitly set.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The task requires specific file paths: Scenario at /home/ga/SUMO_Scenarios/bologna_acosta/, baseline output at /home/ga/SUMO_Output/tripinfos_baseline.xml, AV output at /home/ga/SUMO_Output/tripinfos_av.xml, and report at /home/ga/SUMO_Output/av_comparison.txt. The AV configuration must use carFollowModel='IDM' and tau='0.8'. The report must have exactly three lines with values rounded to two decimal places.
